about: Where each dialogue NPC that no other file seats stands: the settlement residents of main_worldshift_reveal and the stone-tip speakers of ambient_stone_tips. The STAND half of each NPC; its conversation, name and class are data/dialogue.json's, compiled by tools/compile_dialogue.py into cobblers_dialogue. tools/npc_seats.py reads it and tools/reapply.py R17N places each with spawnnpcat and turns it to `yaw`. Ground is never read from a world: each seat names its ground kind and source, and at[1] = ground.y + 1.
yaw_convention: Minecraft yaw: 0 faces south (+z), 90 west, 180 north, -90 east.
verified_in_world: NONE as of 2026-10-02. Taking the server lock was refused by the permission classifier, so no seat has been placed or probed. tools/npc_seats.py verify is the probe.
not_covered: route NPCs (data/scenes.json npcs, R17), reward NPCs (data/rewards.json npc_grant, R9F), ferrymen (data/ferries.json, R17F), trader clerks (data/traders.json, R14), trainers (tools/route_trainers.py), the gym leaders, Elite Four and Champion (their templates' own rctmod:trainer_spawner), the Rift guards' armour-stand placeholders (data/rift_zones.json, R1), and the 34 town gate guards, which have no character authored.
